items.text: Tennessee (early week): CB Cor'Dale Flott (neck), OT Dan Moore Jr. (knee), S Terrell Burgess (knee) all left Wk11 and are being evaluated. IR - RB Tyjae Spears; WR Wan'Dale Robinson out for season. Cam Ward starts.

Jacksonville (early week): LT Walker Little (knee) and CB Jarrian Jones (chest) hurt Wk11, 'no short-term concerns'; RB Bhayshul Tuten (ankle) expected to play; C Robert Hainsey (knee) out last game. Trevor Lawrence starts.
